relabel_edges.name: STRING score rows are a statistical association
relabel_edges.when: predicate = biolink:physically_interacts_with; source = STRINGDB or BioPlex,STRINGDB
relabel_edges.why: STRING combined score (stringdb_score), computed by a pipeline; was knowledge_assertion + manual_agent

relabel_edges.name: BioPlex probability rows are a statistical association
relabel_edges.why: BioPlex interaction probability (bioplex_probability), computed by a pipeline; was knowledge_assertion + manual_agent

relabel_edges.name: placeholder self-pairs have no knowledge level
relabel_edges.why: Pharos placeholder rows without a score (always pruned); was knowledge_assertion + manual_agent

node_rules.name: ChEBI classes in the DTO table are chemical entities
node_rules.why: ChEBI terms (e.g. CHEBI:24431 chemical entity) are not protein families
node_rules.what: CHEBI identifiers typed biolink:ProteinFamily are written as biolink:ChemicalEntity

node_rules.name: Open Targets index terms that are not diseases
node_rules.why: traits, measurements and grouping terms of the Open Targets disease index (e.g. PATO 'amount', UBERON 'life cycle')
node_rules.what: GSSO/OTAR/OBI/NCIT/PATO/OGMS/UBERON identifiers typed biolink:Disease are written as biolink:DiseaseOrPhenotypicFeature

node_rules.name: Ensembl gene accession written as a UniProt id
node_rules.why: an Ensembl gene accession is a gene, not a protein
node_rules.what: identifiers matching `^UniProtKB:(ENSG\d+)$` are written as `ENSEMBL:\1`, then as the NCBI Gene id when HGNC maps it, class biolink:Gene

node_rules.name: Orphanet: written as ORDO:
node_rules.why: two prefixes for the same Orphanet number; ORDO is the one BioLink lists for Disease

kept_as_is.what: primary and aggregator knowledge source infores:opentargets
kept_as_is.why: the infores registry spells it infores:open-targets (data/reference/infores_checked.tsv); the id is kept because the app, the tested questions and the verdict file name the layer by it

the infores registry has no entry for TIN-X (infores:tinx and infores:tin-x looked up: data/reference/infores_checked.tsv), so the aggregator's id is kept; knowledge_level text_co_occurrence and agent_type text_mining_agent already say what the rows are

kept_as_is.what: Protein-protein rows whose source cell names Reactome (Reactome, 'Reactome,STRINGDB', 'BioPlex,Reactome', 'BioPlex,Reactome,STRINGDB'): knowledge_assertion + manual_agent
kept_as_is.why: Reactome is curated by people; the mixed rows keep the curated level although their primary source is written infores:string (the two cells with BioPlex: 2,480 and 6 of the 11,672,660 interaction rows of Pharos 3.19.2, counted in the IntAct corroboration report)
the infores registry has no entry for BioPlex (data/reference/infores_checked.tsv); the id is kept and listed
